title: Q-ASHBY-equivalence: dispose of Ashby keyword Equivalence relation
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** ashbyarchive pass: Ashby's keyword "Equivalence relation" (13 references, pages 4041, 4478, 4778, 5084, 5148, 5165, 5712, 6116, 6167, 6171, 6254, 6505) shares pages with the systems categories and has no disposition
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation ashbyarchive --probe equivalence
**Prediction:** archive_triaged_share >= 1.0 within 720 h
**Out of scope:** copying the journal's wording into the repository; marking a keyword not-applicable without a reason a reader can check
**Status:** open

Read the cited pages (https://ashby.info/journal/index/index.html#equivalence; page images at https://ashby.info/journal/page/NNNN.html, transcribed summaries at https://ashby.info/journal/summaries) and dispose of the keyword in doctrine/ashby-archive.json: add it to a principle (our own statement, the pages, the code that carries it, a probe), or to `not_applicable` with the reason. A principle whose code does not exist yet is status item, with its own item.

size: S

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation ashbyarchive --probe equivalence`
